dataset: DAERA River Water Quality Monitoring 1990-2024, Ammonia (NH4-N); columns StationCode, sample date, NH4-N value, qualifier Q_NH4N
monthly value: first visit of the month (one value per station-month)
censoring: '<' values kept at the LOD; a censored value is a non-exceedance (exceed(): censored and value >= threshold -> False)
exceedance: value > threshold (mg N/L); primary threshold 0.3; also 0.2, 0.4, 0.6
cohort: 281 river stations: >= 8 of 13 monthly-complete years (>= 10 months) in 1995-2007 and 3/3 in 2005-2007
scored months: months of monthly-complete station-years that were sampled in the record; skipped = not in the reduced schedule; visited = in the schedule
cut-off rule: lowest cut-off with <= 0.1 false alarms per station-year on 2005-2007, per method, schedule and threshold; frozen
bootstrap: 1000 replicates, seed 42; station, year and two-way (station x year weights) clusters; percentile 95% intervals
